mainEntity.name: What is AEO and why is it important for law firms?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO stands for Answer Engine Optimization. It's a digital marketing strategy focused on optimizing online content so that it directly answers user questions, particularly those asked on search engines like Google, Bing, and voice assistants. For law firms, AEO is crucial because it helps your practice appear in 'People Also Ask' sections, featured snippets, and voice search results. This visibility can drive more qualified leads by positioning your firm as a direct, authoritative source of information when potential clients search for legal guidance online.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) helps law firms appear in direct answers on search engines and voice assistants, driving more qualified leads.
